name: policy_seed_v1
note: Seeds the 4 policy drafts; each is inserted only for a document that has no version yet, so running it again is safe and never overwrites an edit.

name: help_seed_v1
note: Guide seed; each row says 'on conflict do nothing', so a second run keeps edits (a deleted guide would come back).

name: help_seats_guide
note: Guide seed, 'on conflict do nothing'.

name: help_marketplace_guides
note: Guide seed, 'on conflict do nothing'.

name: admin_exports
note: Do NOT run after 20261046100000: it would put the export list back to 22 datasets.

name: attempt_save_failure_log
note: New in this release. Not applied anywhere yet.

name: owner_batch_steps
note: Replaces the discard function from 20261051100000 (which could not work on the real tables) and makes approve, revoke and discard run in small steps. Safe to run again.

name: fast_subject_list
note: Makes the learner's subject list and the practice builders fast with tens of thousands of questions. Replaces four functions with the same names and shapes, so it is safe to run again. Apply to Preview first and time the subject list.

name: practice_legacy_grade
note: Fixes an empty subject list for a learner stored with the legacy level code B10 (the same year as SHS1). Replaces three functions with the same names and shapes, so it is safe to run again.

name: assessment_blueprint
note: Combined tests by subject and topic (Primary and JHS), a per-subject result breakdown, and a faster teacher topic list. Adds a table and functions and replaces qb_teacher_topics with the same output. Apply to Preview first.

name: topics_for_teachers
note: Admin functions to open topics to teachers in bulk (per subject and grade) and an overview of what is ready. Adds two functions; safe to run again.

name: mixed_practice
note: Practice across several subjects for Primary and JHS learners (one new function). Safe to run again.

name: practice_question_limit
note: Raises the practice set limit from 30 to 100 questions (replaces three functions with the same names and shapes). Safe to run again.

name: challenge_bank_sections
note: Challenge and competition questions from the bank by class level, subject and topic (three new functions) and the older subject-code pull now takes approved questions only. Safe to run again.

name: challenge_bank_levels_with_questions
note: The class levels offered for adding bank questions to a challenge are now only those that have approved questions (one function replaced, same name and shape). Safe to run again.

name: challenge_bank_levels_fast
note: Faster class-level list for adding bank questions to a challenge (one function replaced, same name and shape). Safe to run again.

name: challenge_participants
note: The creator's Results tab can list each person's attempts (adds one function, challenge_participants). Safe to run again.

name: class_join_level_check
note: Joining a class by code now refuses a learner whose class level differs from the class (two functions replaced, same names and shapes). Safe to run again.

name: attempt_review_explanations
note: The attempt review now carries each question's explanation (one function replaced, same name and shape). Safe to run again.

name: challenge_live_details
note: A creator can fix the title, description and closing time of a live challenge; ended challenges and past or back-to-front dates are refused (one function replaced, same name and shape). Safe to run again.

name: student_profile_edits
note: A signed-in learner can edit their own class level, school and subjects, twice in any six months (adds one table and two functions). Safe to run again.

name: repeat_assignments
note: Repeat-weekly assignments and a due-soon reminder, OFF until flags.repeat_assignments is set to true (adds two tables, a schema and ten functions, and one flag row). Nothing is sent or published while the flag is off. Safe to run again.

name: school_aimed_sponsored
note: Staff can aim a challenge at one verified school, behind a flag that is OFF (adds three columns, one flag row and three functions, and replaces two functions with the same names and shapes). Safe to run again. Apply to Preview first.

name: teacher_profile_edit
note: A teacher can edit their own name, school, subjects and grades taught, OFF until flags.teacher_profile_edit is set to true (adds one history table, two functions and one flag row). Safe to run again.

name: staff_access
note: A Super Admin can give staff connected workflows (content, support, finance) by email, OFF until flags.staff_access is set to true (adds one schema, seven functions and one flag row; every change is audited). Safe to run again.

name: fix_any_topic_delete
note: Fixes Any topic in Assign by subject and topic, which failed with DELETE requires a WHERE clause (replaces one function; changes no data). Safe to run again.

name: batch_preview_fast
note: Approve Batches, Review sample: the preview took about 32 s on 36,718 questions. Adds one helper function and one index on questions, and replaces one function; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: owner_batch_steps_fast
note: Approve Batches: the approve, revoke and discard steps no longer scan the whole questions table, and the approve step validates only until a full step is found. Replaces three functions; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: school_directory
note: School directory (off until flags.school_directory is switched on): one table of schools by region and district with a Public / Private filter, the add-a-school queue, and the staff approve, merge and import functions. Adds one table, two nullable columns and functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: school_directory_analytics
note: School directory screen: one read-only function for the figures and charts, and the list function re-created with filters (region, district, Public / Private, level) and sorting. Changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: social_channels
note: Social channels managed from the admin (off until flags.social_channels is switched on): one table seeded with the six channels the app shows today, a public read function, and super admin functions to add, edit, hide, reorder and delete (WhatsApp numbers, Telegram and more). Adds one table and functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: admin_dashboard
note: Admin dashboard figures in one read-only function for staff: users, learning activity, content, queues, markets and schools, each section computed on its own. Adds one function; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: student_subjects
note: Lets a learner choose their subjects from inside the workspace after sign-up, without using up one of the two profile edits. Adds one function; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: family_workspace
note: Family workspace, phase 1 (off until flags.family_workspace is switched on): a workspace for a parent, guardian or academic parent, family link types and permissions on the existing account_relationships table, and the access-checking functions. Adds one table, two columns and functions; changes no existing relationship. Safe to run again.

name: family_children
note: Family workspace, phase 2 (off until flags.family_workspace is on): add a child, a single-use invitation stored as a hash, and linking an existing student that the student must accept. Adds one table, one column and functions; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: family_assignments
note: Family workspace, phase 4a (off until flags.family_workspace is on): a hidden family class per class level so a parent can give their children work through the existing assignment engine, a family stamp on assignments, and the parent progress view. Adds two columns, one index, a trigger and two functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: family_orders
note: Family workspace, phases 6 and 7 (off until flags.family_workspace is on): one checkout for the children a parent ticks, for Coins or subscriptions, settled for every child or none and exactly once, plus each child wallet and plan view. Adds two tables and functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: family_progress_admin
note: Family workspace, phases 9 and 10: read-only progress functions for a parent (only for children they may follow) and read-only staff views of families. Adds functions only; changes no data. Safe to run again.

name: family_library
note: Family workspace, phase 5 (off until flags.family_workspace is on): a parent gives a Marketplace set they bought to chosen children without copying it; the child plays the original while the purchase lasts. Adds one table and functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: family_challenges
note: Family workspace, phase 4b (off until flags.family_workspace is on): a parent invites chosen children to a challenge they made; the child sees it with its access code and plays it in the normal play page. Adds one table and functions; changes no existing data. Safe to run again.

name: help_guides_refresh
note: Help centre, 16 Nov 2026: three guides refreshed (only where no admin has edited them) and thirteen new guides: a way-round guide, subjects, the school card, work from school and family, assign by topic, and the family workspace guides (drafts until the feature is on). Adds rows only; never overwrites an admin edit. Safe to run again.

name: parent_accounts
note: Parent accounts, 16 Nov 2026: adds the parent role and parent_profiles (stored like sponsor_profiles). Sign-up of a parent is refused until flags.family_workspace is on. Children stay linked through account_relationships. Safe to run again.

name: parent_family_help
note: Help centre: a parent guide, 'Parents and guardians: create your family workspace' (published, Sponsors tab; rows only, 'on conflict do nothing'). Explains sign-up as a sponsor, adding or linking a child, and privacy. Safe to run again.

name: parents_sign_up_as_sponsor
note: Parents sign up as sponsors: onboarding no longer accepts the parent role (replaces qb_complete_onboarding, one function). Sponsors can mark themselves INDIVIDUAL; organizations keep ORGANIZATION. Family workspace tools are unchanged. Safe to run again.

name: family_sponsor_links
note: Family workspace: a sponsor who asks to link to a student does so as a sponsor (sponsor permissions only: progress, Coins and subscriptions; no assigning). Every other adult still links as a parent. Replaces qb_family_link_request. Safe to run again.

name: family_guardian_and_staff_approval
note: Family workspace: a sponsor can link to any student, including a school-managed or under-13 child. A child with a linked parent or guardian is asked through that guardian first; a child with none is approved by QuizBox staff. Managed children never see or answer requests. Replaces the link request, the request list and the answer functions; adds guardian and staff approval functions. Safe to run again.

name: sponsor_alumni_type
note: Sign-up accepts a third sponsor type, ALUMNI (alumni or old students' association). Replaces qb_complete_onboarding, one function. Safe to run again.

name: family_alumni_applications
note: Alumni sponsors apply for approval to create a family and add selected students. Approved by QuizBox staff or by the administrator of the named school. Adds one table (no client access), a guard on opening a family workspace and four functions; parents and organizations are not affected. Run 20261117140000 first. Safe to run again.

name: class_join_assignment_catch_up
note: A learner who joins a class later now receives its open class-wide assignments (trigger plus a one-off backfill). Family classes and chosen-learner work are untouched. Safe to run again.

name: question_policy_speed
note: Question Banks, Editorial Review and Curriculum Coverage stop timing out on a large question table: the access rules work out the user's context and allowed source documents once per query instead of once per row, and the role once per query. Same rows stay visible. Adds two functions and an index on questions(created_at); replaces three policies on questions. Safe to run again.

name: topic_title_fixes
note: Corrects four mis-typed topic names learners see (English B4-B6 Conversation topic trailing comma, English B5 Using Action Words, Creative Arts B5 Planning, Making and Composing). Title text only. Safe to run again.

name: learner_profile_write_guards
note: Closes four gaps found by the December readiness gate: a learner can no longer write their own student or teacher profile row (minor flag, managed-by, self-made teacher profile), a teacher can no longer write an assignment into another teacher's class, and class join codes must be unique ignoring letter case and at least 10 characters. Server functions are untouched. Rollback: supabase/rollback/learner_profile_write_guards.sql.

name: reassert_browser_role_grants
note: States again the rules Production already has: a signed-in user may update only their own profile name (not their role), and browser roles hold no TRUNCATE, REFERENCES or TRIGGER on public tables. Fixes Preview, which was rebuilt with open default grants. No change on Production. Rollback: supabase/rollback/reassert_browser_role_grants.sql.

name: xp_only_for_answers
note: Reward points follow the answers given: a paper with nothing answered earns no completion points, and the completion bonus is the share of the paper answered (20 for a full paper). Changes one line inside the live core_qb_complete_attempt, read from the database; stops with XP_LINE_NOT_FOUND if the line is not there. Existing rewards are untouched. Rollback: supabase/rollback/xp_only_for_answers.sql.

name: help_guides_corrections
note: Help centre text corrections from the 20 Nov guide audit: removes links to hidden drafts in the learner and teacher start guides, fixes what a parent's link to an existing child allows, the parent sign-up wording and the under-13 class-code line. Rows only; guides an administrator edited are left alone; safe to run again. Rollback: supabase/rollback/help_guides_corrections.sql.

name: student_class_cards
note: Adds qb_student_class_cards(): for the signed-in learner, each active class with the teacher's name, the number of active learners and the open assignments. Read only; safe to run again. Rollback: supabase/rollback/student_class_cards.sql.

name: family_link_privacy
note: Parent link requests are listed with a masked address for 14 days whether or not the email has an account, so the waiting list no longer reveals who has an account. Adds family_link_notes, qb_family_note_link_request and qb_family_pending_requests. Safe to run again. Rollback: supabase/rollback/family_link_privacy.sql.

name: sponsor_verification
note: Sponsor verification for organisations: adds who decided, when and why on sponsor_profiles, a queue for super administrators (qb_admin_sponsor_queue) and a decision function (qb_admin_sponsor_decide, a decline needs a reason, the sponsor is notified, audited). Shown, not enforced. Safe to run again. Rollback: supabase/rollback/sponsor_verification.sql.

name: mock_exams_authoring
note: Mock exams part 1 of 3, off behind flags.mock_exams: tables for exams, rounds, chosen questions and immutable published versions, and the functions to build an exam across years (year, subject, topic, count), choose questions without substitution or duplicates, review and publish a version. Tables and settings are kept on rollback. Rollback: supabase/rollback/mock_exams_authoring.sql.

name: mock_exams_delivery
note: Mock exams part 2 of 3: assign a published version to a class through qb_publish_assignment, and the owner-only results, student-by-question review and export dataset. Needs 20261122100000. Rollback: supabase/rollback/mock_exams_delivery.sql.

name: mock_exams_marketplace
note: Mock exams part 3 of 3: sell an exam as a Marketplace listing pinned to a published version, open the buyer's private copy of the purchased version, and refuse attempts without a live purchase (trigger on attempts). Needs 20261043100000 and the two earlier mock-exam migrations. Rollback: supabase/rollback/mock_exams_marketplace.sql.

name: family_guides_published
note: Publishes the 8 family guides as one set (only unedited drafts). Run only when the Family workspace is open on that database. Safe to run again. Rollback: supabase/rollback/family_guides_published.sql.

name: mock_exams_sponsor_delivery
note: Mock exams part 4 of 4, links off behind flags.mock_exam_links: a sponsor gives an exam to the children they may assign work to, or shares it by link for places paid for in Coins (1 Coin each); learners take their own private copy of the shared version. Verified alumni sponsors and family sponsors may now build. Needs the three earlier mock-exam migrations. Rollback: supabase/rollback/mock_exams_sponsor_delivery.sql.
